verdict.rationale: The `.forget` operation is explicitly documented as the unified deletion command supporting single data item deletion, dataset deletion, and 'full cleanup: remove everything the current user can delete' — directly matching single-memory, per-entity (dataset-scoped), and full-erasure use cases, and a runtime probe confirms `cognee-cli forget --dataset demo` actually tears down data. Missing for 10: no explicit granular entity-node-level deletion (vs. dataset-level) example, and no independent/audit evidence confirming full erasure meets formal privacy-compliance standards (e.g., GDPR right-to-be-forgotten certification).
